I'm Peyman Kor, a Data Scientist and Machine Learning/AI researcher. I grew up in [Bandar Torkaman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bandar_Torkaman){target="_blank"} north of Iran and currently finishing my Ph.D. in Norway.

My focus is on AI/ML models and I am currently exploring how Generative AI and the Agentic AI workflow can lead to optimizing and automating the process. 

As my PhD topic, I worked on [Reinforcement Learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reinforcement_learning){target="_blank"}. Both in the context of how we can use Reinforcement Learning in the more classical method like [Q-learning](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/17/9/400){target="_blank"}, but also how Reinforcement Learning can be used in generative AI in the frame of [Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback](https://github.com/Peymankor/RLHF/blob/main/main.pdf){target="_blank"}. 

Previously, I studied at Technical University of Denmark and worked on various computational projects. I graduated from University of Stavanger with M.Sc in Engineering, where I specialized in developing practical ML solutions for real-world problems.

I'm active on GitHub and frequently publish my research findings in my blog. You can find my work in various academic publications and technical blogs.

I enjoy tackling challenging technical problems and collaborating with innovative teams.
